2.9. Procedure
All students and their parents signed an informed consent form
in order to participate in this study. The study was conducted dur-
ing the second academic quarter of the school year, and the GPA
and VSOL measures were obtained from school records. The stu-
dents were recruited from 20 classes, and the gender of the teach-
ers of these classes was 6 males and 14 females. The students’ SD
and SR scales were administered during their homeroom period.
